ns2:section.sectionText: This course discusses major topics in corporate finance: firms make decisions to increase the value of the firm for their shareholders. In the first part, we will evaluate investment projects and decide whether the firm should take or reject a project. We will also learn how to value bonds and stocks. In the second part, we will study the relationship between risk and returns. Capital asset pricing model, arbitrage and stock options will be introduced. In the third part, we will talk about firms’ capital structure and payout policy. We will investigate how to apply the principles in a real-world setting by working on group projects. ********RESTRICTED TO ECON-LAS MAJORS.
